fact: A workshop on consulting services for implementing the Tunisian real-estate information management system (TLIS) was held in Tunis on 13 November 2023, with the OTC and the Korean consultant GEOMEXSOFT JV supervising implementation, including digitisation of land archives.
title: Immobilier : Vers la mise en oeuvre du projet TLIS pour améliorer la gestion du patrimoine foncier
